Complete template.description: A complete DSL v1 template with a settings section and HTML layout
body: @template "${1:New landing}" description="${2:A configurable landing page}" version=1

Settings section.description: Group settings into a form section

Text setting.description: A typed setting with a quoted default and form label

WYSIWYG setting.description: A visual rich-text editor with links and images; render with {{& path}}

Markdown setting.description: A Markdown editor with images and preview; render with {{& path}}

Formatted editor content.description: Render sanitized HTML from a Wysiwyg or Markdown field inside an HTML body container

AI instructions.description: AI instructions for a field or a reusable block (append to @param or @block)

Color setting.description: A color picker with a hexadecimal default

Range setting.body: @param ${1:fontSize} Range = ${2:18} label="${3:Font size}" min=${4:14} max=${5:24} step=${6:1}$0

Select setting.description: A select field with value:Label choices

Image setting.description: An image URL, bundled asset path, or upload setting
Image setting.body: @param ${1:logo} Image label="${2:Logo}" help="${3:Enter a URL or upload an image.}"$0

Repeatable custom type.description: Declare a record and its repeatable setting

Reusable block.description: A reusable HTML block with a typed argument

Render block.description: Render an existing block with a parameter path

Loop.description: Iterate an existing array of an author-defined record type

Conditional.description: Render content when an existing parameter is truthy

Include fragment.description: Include a source fragment relative to the ZIP package root

Interpolate field.description: Insert an HTML-escaped parameter or nested field

Image with aspect ratio.description: An image crop with a fixed aspect ratio and adjustable output width

Image with output sizes.description: An image crop with a choice of exact output sizes

Preview data.description: Optional JSON object used only for the generated template preview

Public preview URL.description: Public HTTP(S) page or image; takes precedence over previewData

Request validation.description: Validate page-local runtime query, headers or body values before rendering

Runtime request macro.description: Insert a request-time macro; * serializes the complete source as JSON
